headline: Papua New Guinea Releases National Money-Laundering Risk Report
summary: Bank of Papua New Guinea released its national risk assessment identifying corruption and public fraud as primary threats ahead of mandatory 2027 financial compliance deadlines.
why: Financial action task force assessments dictate banking correspondent relationships and cross-border settlement costs for developing Pacific economies.

impacts.name: Papua New Guinea
impacts.why: Enhanced anti-money laundering monitoring requires regulatory reforms in the domestic banking sector.
